description:
Police-recorded offences in Queensland by suburb, per calendar year for 2022-2025, by broad offence type.

Coverage: Queensland: 3,015 suburbs; calendar years 2022-2025. Excludes sexual offences and breaches of domestic-violence orders, which police do not map publicly (about a quarter of all recorded offences); for complete totals use the council-level Queensland dataset. Current to 2025-12-31. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/recorded-crime-qld-suburb`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_offences, arson, assault, drug_offences, fraud, gaming_racing_and_betting_offences, good_order_offences, handling_stolen_goods, homicide_murder, liquor_excl_drunkenness, miscellaneous_offences, other_homicide, other_offences_against_the_person, other_property_damage, other_theft_excl_unlawful_entry, prostitution_offences, robbery, stock_related_offences, traffic_and_related_offences, trespassing_and_vagrancy, unlawful_entry, unlawful_use_of_motor_vehicle, weapons_act_offences. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: suburbs_crime_recorded_offences_qld_suburbs
title: Recorded crime by suburb (Queensland)
